newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Anglo eyes ventures with Araneta group.
newsitem.headline: Anglo eyes ventures with Araneta group.

text.p: Anglo Philippine Holdings Corp said on Friday it had signed an agreement with Progressive Development Corp, the owner of a Manila commercial hub, to explore joint venture opportunities.

Anglo told the Philippine Stock Exchange that the two groups "agreed to pursue areas of future cooperation with the view to enhancing the value of properties owned by either of the two companies or by their respective affiliates or subsidiaries."
Progressive is the owner and developer of the Araneta centre in suburban Manila. Progressive is owned by the landed Araneta family.
As an initial venture, the two companies will develop one of the major rail stations in a mass railway system traversing a major Manila thoroughfare.
